notes.title: MAJOR UPDATE: SPILL ZONE OUT NOW
notes.content:
[h1]SPILL ZONE is out now! [/h1][h2](And we're 20% off!)
[/h2][previewyoutube="t0w6P93ZUm0;full"][/previewyoutube][h2][b]_____[/b][/h2][p][/p][h1][b]SPILL ZONE [/b][/h1][h1][b]Early Access Update #4 - 0.7 Notes[/b][/h1][p][/p][p]Today's update brings you [b]Spill Zone[/b], an all-new escape Plan set in a noxious industrial district that introduces a new cast of characters, new locations to explore, and multiple new game endings, depending on your choices. But not every decision is as it seems, and not all roads lead to safety…[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43342513/af3f3cb74dbe3f71f755d9f4a698b3da35067ae4.png"][/img][/p][p][b]NOTE:[/b] While you [b]can[/b] technically play Spill Zone from your existing save, we do [b]strongly recommend starting a new playthrough[/b] for this update.

[/p][h2][b]Major New Features[/b]
[/h2][list][*][p]Added new [b]leads[/b] and a new [b]unlockable Escape Plan[/b], Spill Zone.
[/p][/*][*][p]Added a [b]new district[/b], the [spoiler]Alto District.[/spoiler]
[/p][/*][*][p]Added [b]new locations[/b]: [spoiler]Skip’s Scoops Ice Cream Parlour, CDC Field Station, Chiefways Transport Depot, Chiefways Distillation Towers, Chiefways Administrative Complex, Chiefways Operations Center, Chiefways Boiler Unit, and The Pit.[/spoiler]
[/p][/*][*][p]Added [b]new curveballs[/b].
[/p][/*][*][p]Added a [b]new weapon[/b], [spoiler]the Splitting Maul.[/spoiler]
[/p][/*][*][p]Added a [b]new item[/b], [spoiler]the Hazmat suit.[/spoiler]
[/p][/*][*][p]Added [b]new NPCs[/b].
[/p][/*][*][p]Added a [b]new recruitable survivor[/b].
[/p][/*][*][p]Added [b]new endings[/b].
  [/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43342513/04c0cf8563ecac4e790bbeca18ead0cc88d14d07.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]
Firearms Balancing [/b][/h2][list][*][p]All ammo now takes two crafting slots instead of three.[/p][/*][*][p]The rifle ammo crafting recipe now produces two ammo instead of one.[/p][/*][*][p]The Assault Rifle can now be found in certain locked loot points.[/p][/*][*][p]The chance of firearms appearing in late game loot points has increased.[/p][/*][*][p]Certain locked loot points now guarantee a weapon.
[/p][/*][/list][h2][b]Steam Deck Improvements[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Adjusted Steam Deck graphics settings for better performance on the device.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted text size across most UI in the game for better readability.[/p][/*][*][p]Added SteamOS onscreen keyboard support.[/p][/*][*][p][b](We'll be applying for verification shortly - keep an eye out!)[/b]  
[/p][/*][/list][h2][b]Adjustments[/b][/h2][list][*][p]The player's save file is now no longer deleted after completing a plan.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the world difficulty system so that it can also increase with your survivors’ progress in a Plan. [/p][/*][*][p]Limited the crafting queue so survivors can only queue up to two phases of work. [/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the loot point at the Indigo Rose reception so it now requires a lockpick to open.[/p][/*][*][p]Added back the [spoiler]surprise zombie in Value Records.[/spoiler][/p][/*][*][p]Minor improvements to aiming animations.[/p][/*][*][p]Minor improvements to the animations of recruitable characters during conversations to better transition when the player skips dialogue.[/p][/*][*][p]Minor improvements to some state animations when in shelter plus a few new variations for some, including Tired, Exhausted, Bleeding, Queasy, Severe Sunburn, and High Fever.[/p][/*][*][p]Dismantling the Video Camera now gives two Electrical rather than one Component.[/p][/*][*][p]Added the ability to switch sides when in cover spots that protect survivors from both sides.[/p][/*][*][p]Items with full durability now stack in the shelter inventory.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated the hand pose of the screamer zombie.[/p][/*][*][p]Added new firearm hit reacts for the large and armored zombies.[/p][/*][*][p]Added improvements to bullet impact effects on some surfaces to better match the material that was hit.[/p][/*][*][p]Added new firing sound effects to the D9 Defender pistol.[/p][/*][*][p]Added new blood effects for firearm impacts and executions.[/p][/*][*][p]Added dry fire clicks when shooting an empty firearm.[/p][/*][*][p]Added unique reload sounds for each firearm.
[/p][/*][/list][h2][b]Fixes[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where moving shelter sometimes didn't work if survivors were moving back to a shelter that they had already been in.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where some of the footstep audio in Best Electronics did not match the surface the scavenger was walking on.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where human NPCs would sometimes freeze in place after spotting or entering combat with the player.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an incorrect title in a loot point at the Thirty Ought Six Bar.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where survivors would do a little jump when they ran out the left side of the Thirty Ought Six Bar while scavenging.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where some ledge hang animations had the survivor hanging in the air a short distance from the actual ledge.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where Plan objectives would still appear if survivors did them before they unlocked the Plan.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed most instances where a survivor would stumble after climbing up from a ledge.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where zombies would get stuck running in place on the ledge when a survivor was standing on the edge of a jump.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the camera was closer while aiming from cover without a firearm than being in cover and not aiming.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the throwing arc would sometimes disappear.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where some effects like smoke weren't showing behind window glass.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where a survivor could still dodge while in cover. The survivor will now exit cover and then dodge.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where exiting the pre-scavenge equip menu after transferring weapons and reopening the menu could result in the wrong weapons being loaded into the backpack.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the crafting recipe for the Brute Double so it now uses Firearm Parts to craft.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43342513/39942cb0685e621ef8931b13abb2f6a3605eab54.png"][/img][/p][h1][b]Coming for Update #5 in October[/b][/h1][p][/p][p]We're bringing you: [/p][list][*][p][b]Survivor missions[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]New starting pair[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Save multiple runs[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43342513/c6119ea843c8fb9431582a5525f763fdfc089a4e.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]See you in Walton City, folks. (And don't forget to come chat with the dev team in the Discord: [url="https://discord.gg/Xd8RPnRZjx"]https://discord.gg/Xd8RPnRZjx[/url])


Harriet &[/p][p]the Into the Dead team[/p]

notes.title: Early Access Update #3: Firearms
notes.content:
[h1]We're live![/h1][p][/p][previewyoutube="d60oSGOA-GU;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h2][b]_____
[/b][/h2][p][/p][h1][b]Early Access Update #3 v0.6 Notes[/b][/h1][h2][b]
Firearms[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]We've added new firearms! From today's update, the game will now include:[/p][p][/p][list][*][p][b]ARC-4 Guerilla Assault rifle[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]F300 Carbine rifle[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]M5 Cuthbert rifle[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Colossus shotgun[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Brute Double shotgun[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]G911 Enforcer pistol[/b] [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]We've also done some reworking and improving of firearms gameplay in general. Firearms now:[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]do [b]different amounts of damage[/b] depending on the[b] body part[/b] hit[/p][/*][*][p]show [b]blood effects[/b] where they hit[/p][/*][*][p]have damage falloff so they do [b]less damage at range[/b][/p][/*][*][p]are less [b]noisy [/b][/p][/*][*][p]cause [b]different hit reactions[/b] in enemies depending on force.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]As your survivors move about Walton City, you'll also notice:[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]More [b]locked loot points[/b] have been added to levels. These are more likely to have weapons and uncommon crafting materials like Fasteners, Tape, Electrical, and Firearms Parts in them.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Firearm Parts[/b], broken and whole versions of firearms, and [b]ammo[/b] have been [b]distributed[/b] around the map.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Pistols [/b]can now be [b]crafted[/b] at the Level 1 weapons bench.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Recipes[/b] have been added for crafting and dismantling the new firearms.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Other New Content[/b]
[/h2][list][*][p]Added a [b]throwable arc [/b]indicator that appears while aiming a throwable, which shows the arc of the throwable's path and where it will land.[/p][/*][*][p]Added [b]new Curveballs.
 [/b][/p][/*][/list][h2][b]Adjustments[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Added new animations to reflect survivor States.[/p][/*][*][p]Opening doors while crouching/stealthing will show different animations than when standing up.[/p][/*][*][p]Added new warnings to the pre-game warning screen.[/p][/*][*][p]Looting will now make a small amount of noise and could alert zombies very close to your survivor.[/p][/*][*][p]Landing a jump from a ledge now generates noise that an enemy can hear.[/p][/*][*][p]The loading screen background now matches the day/night phase the game is on.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated set dressing and lighting in RM&K Communications. [/p][/*][*][p]Added a tutorial tip for how to sprint.[/p][/*][*][p]Added different zombie types to different difficulties at Milwood Manor, Container Yard #3, Hackett Construction Inc and St Bernadette Hospital.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated the knockback amounts and attack speeds for human NPCs using the machete.[/p][/*][*][p] [spoiler]Killing Corbin during the "good ending" for the Network plan will now give your survivor the Guilt State. [/spoiler][/p][/*][*][p]Added unique vocalizations to each zombie type.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved footstep audio in Texas Sports Supply to better reflect the surface a survivor is walking on.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved audio for the [spoiler] zombie tied up on the bed in the Indigo Rose. It should now be muffled by walls and floors. [/spoiler][/p][/*][*][p]Survivors and NPCs now ragdoll when they die from falling, instead of just collapsing onto the ground.[/p][/*][*][p]When NPCs are hit, they more accurately ragdoll at the location and amount of force they were hit with.[/p][/*][*][p]Shortened the timer of the grenade to 2 seconds, and increased the surface friction so it slides less after landing. This is to make it more predictable where it will land and explode.
[/p][/*][/list][h2][b]Fixes[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Fixed enemies attacking the player through walls and doors.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixes the issue where zombies appeared cut off or sinking into the floor.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug with camera movement in the Schrader Street shelter.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug in Fire Station No.13 where zombies were getting stuck on the stairs.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the rest area's UI did not show the title properly in Thai.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where loot in a starting shelter would "restock" when your survivors moved out. Fixed a similar issue in the tutorial locations where loot and zombies would reset once the player finished the tutorial. In both cases, the amount of loot and zombies should remain the same as when your survivors left it.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where moving shelters put survivors back in their previous shelter and the game became non-responsive.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where certain female characters did not have footstep sounds in the shelter.[/p][/*][*][p] [spoiler]Fixed the background building at the 9th Precinct Station exploding every time a survivor returned to that location. [/spoiler] This now only happens once per playthrough.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where, if survivors aimed while in the middle of a melee attack, they would keep melee-ing instead of throwing their throwable or shooting their gun.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where State gained UI can pop up during the death screen.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]And coming in September for Update #4[/b][/h2][p]
[b]Spill Zone[/b], an all new Plan to escape Walton City, is coming in September....[/p][p]
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43342513/d0c3462ec1db4d89e31ddd13342a2e08344f40b6.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Don't forget to join us in the Discord: [url="https://discord.gg/Xd8RPnRZjx"]https://discord.gg/Xd8RPnRZjx[/url]


Harriet &[/p][p]the Into the Dead team 
[/p]

- We've added new firearms! From today's update, the game will now include:
- ARC-4 Guerilla Assault rifle

tags.bug: - Fixed enemies attacking the player through walls and doors.
- Fixes the issue where zombies appeared cut off or sinking into the floor.
- Fixed a bug with camera movement in the Schrader Street shelter.
- Fixed a bug in Fire Station No.13 where zombies were getting stuck on the stairs.
- Fixed a bug where the rest area's UI did not show the title properly in Thai.

- Fixed an issue where loot in a starting shelter would "restock" when your survivors moved out. Fixed a similar issue in the tutorial locations where loot and zombies would reset once the player finished the tutorial. In both cases, the amount of loot and zombies should remain the same as when your survivors left it.

notes.title: Early Access Update #2: Infection, Difficulty and New Zombie Threats

Infection[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]What would a zombie game be without infection? From today's update, if your survivor is attacked by a zombie while out scavenging, there is now a chance of getting a [b]Deep Wound[/b]. A Deep Wound will slowly reduce your survivor's health and can [b]sometimes [/b]carry[b] [/b]a zombie infection. A Deep Wound can also cause a [b]High Fever [/b]State, which causes survivors to take more damage in combat. Your survivor may pull through with nothing but a scar, or they may become [b]Infected[/b]. It's up to you to decide if it's worth the risk of keeping them in your shelter…[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfy-j1dDhfRWtdIlw9NUa3d3JWJiRgwEdEWL2qz68vZX6vwnrPkmvRMTQimgcIS1zhmLc8BjavD842HD_QcCu-ZIHlg5tHdwPRsiuB0MKpKcPKh6RmUU2WGH19t9KH-LKAvytusjg?key=Y63urAGN6qziaHzsMFfglw"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Difficulty Settings
[/b][/h2][p]The power is in your hands! You can now select a difficulty setting at the start of a playthrough. Available settings are [b]Casual[/b], [b]Normal[/b], [b]Hard[/b] and [b]Custom[/b]. Difficulty settings adjust factors including survivor needs, damage taken, enemy health, barricades, stealth sensitivity, resources, infection risk and phase restarts. For players updating their game in the middle of a playthrough, their difficulty will default to Normal. You cannot adjust your difficulty in the middle of a playthrough.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXf5oAJ40k2ICoWKcugFqKeeEhy_Gr7ZoLvxseYmfm_hoIRkWo6U_nCSDDIR_vNfNGsjigBv0fmhZ4MMtjg_J7g6WXqdE0Ch9xKmBH8xkflkD0H6Ly8g1SsT1f2dWeXPqjy41zM9ag?key=Y63urAGN6qziaHzsMFfglw"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]New Zombie Threats[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]Walton City is less predictable than ever. There are now a multitude of new zombie threats beginning to appear across the city, that may behave in different ways than before…[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXdm4iEn5N57box3zKUSazUlpHFCxUFfDfuyDNLXjoQtn1dziDRtD1mWptifTTqL9qM0HkPRcIJihRR7jIsr7F2YFnfKdd6WsBqFEkG-ak76BJ1Pii6tCwAvGVm8RM4QzIZSnrG6TA?key=Y63urAGN6qziaHzsMFfglw"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Other New Content[/b][/h2][p][/p][list][*][p]Added [b]Eviction[/b]. tags.balance_change: Adjusted the Shelter Stations so survivors are now always able to use them, even if their needs are very low. The only exception is if they have the Broken Wrist State.

Adjusted consumable items so survivors can now use them while they are out scavenging. Items that require a phase to take effect still won't be instant. Players will need to return to their shelter alive to gain the effect of these items after consuming.
Adjusted Hunger drain for Normal difficulty. Survivors now lose about 15% less Hunger per phase.
Adjusted the dodge mechanic so your survivor will always dodge, even if they're in the middle of attacking.
Adjusted zombie group combat so only the one at the front can do uninterruptible retaliation attacks on your survivor.
Adjusted zombie group combat so that zombies in a group can no longer be knocked down by melee attacks. (They can still be knocked down by bricks that are aimed at them.)

Adjusted the difficulty of locations so that it can now increase as the game advances forward in time. This will impact the zombie spawns of some stages, with new zombies appearing in stages that have been visited before.
Rebalanced human NPCs to recover less health when they get up after being knocked down.

Improved the line of sight system that blurs where the survivor can't see while scavenging. It should now better represent what a survivor would see and have fewer graphical issues and less blurring at the edges.
Adjusted the Queasy State. The amount of Hunger survivors get back from eating  food is reduced by 35% while they have the Queasy State.
Renamed a number of States, including "Drained" to "Tired", "Collapsing" to "Exhausted", "Gnawing Hunger" to "Starving" and "Depressed" to "Hopeless".
Added (Fatal) variants to States that highlight that a survivor may die from these in an upcoming phase if not alleviated.
Adjusted survivor death so that if they die due to a needs related cause, they will die before the Day Log shows up in the phase.
Renamed the "Fuel" item to "Gasoline".
Reduced the noise range of Throwables that aren't noise-centric.
Added new hit reactions for zombies to non-knife weapon attacks.
Improved the Makeshift Hammer attack animations
Changed the animations for knife weapons to be stabs. Affects Scalpel, Screwdriver, Broken Bottle, Scissors and Makeshift Knife.
Adjusted the animation for when survivors fail a door barge.
Moved the trigger point for the [spoiler]massacre area[/spoiler] in RM&K Communications.
Adjusted the Plan UI so players can now unpin a Plan, and even if there is no Plan pinned, players will still get a notification if they complete a Plan's objectives.
Adjusted scavenge assignment so that when the player cancels a scavenge, the items they equipped from that scavenge will still be there the next time they assign a survivor.
Added text to the Barricade attack screen that appears when the Barricade damage amount is increasing.

Added UI improvements. While in the Shelter, clicking on your current survivor's portrait or State will open up their Survivor info screen, and hovering the mouse over most buttons in the game will put it into a selected State (when using keyboard and mouse).
Changed crafting screens so that recipes that survivors currently can't craft are now greyed out.
Added glyphs to indicate to the player where survivors can crawl under.
Decreased the number of skulls on the Map location information panel.
Updated the Six-Pack icon to show a six pack instead of a bottle.
Made the character portraits a bit more crisp.
Added visual polish to some industrial building models.

tags.bug: Fixed the pistol's aiming angle to better represent where it's shooting.
Fixed the issue where the Map was saying "new locations discoverable" for Millwood Manor as this location does not have a Vantage Point.
Fixed zombies sometimes spawning inside the fridge at 15 Independence Blvd.
Fixed the issue of footsteps sounding too quiet when indoors.
Fixed the scale of Christine's model for scavenging so her animations line up properly.
Stopped [spoiler] Lester's stash [/spoiler] being shown as available loot on the Map when players didn't have it unlocked via his Shelter Event.
Fixed an issue with double-sided cover spots where survivors would sometimes still get spotted.
Fixed vaulting so survivors are less likely to bump into a nearby zombie while trying to sneak up on them.
Fixed an issue where some doors would only break to the right, regardless of which direction they were barged from.
Fixed an issue where sometimes a knocked-down enemy would get up and then immediately do a retaliation attack on survivors.
Fixed an issue where survivors could get stuck after trying to ground-execute an enemy near or behind doors and walls.

Fixed an issue when transferring items while scavenging. After the player transfers the last item out of a loot point, they will stay selected on the empty loot point instead of shifting selection into their survivor’s backpack. This prevents the player from accidentally transferring items back to the loot point when clicking fast.
Fixed a bug where you could attempt to assign a second survivor to the Map station at Texas Sports Supply before you had upgraded the Map Station.
Fixed an issue where survivors could get stuck on the ladder at Texway Gas Hart St.
Fixed an issue where the Nightmare State could also affect the amount of Rest gained from drinking Coffee.
Fixed an issue where characters could get knocked down or react in the wrong direction when they are hit with a projectile.
Fixed an issue where zombies won't attack survivors if they are just outside of the left entrance of St Bernadette Hospital.
Fixed an issue in Texway Gas Green St where there was a zombie who wouldn't attack survivors until they were hit.
Reduced some flickering around the Kinski Foundation Gallery background.

notes.title: Early Access Update #1: Curveballs, Zurvivors and Pipe Bombs
notes.content:
Well, here it is, folks! Our very first Early Access update is now live. 

[previewyoutube=HZc861DN5_c;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Important things to note:[/h2]

[h3]This update includes some [b]cool new features[/b].[/h3]
Curveballs! Zombified survivors! Pipe bombs! Seedy hotels! We're excited to see you get into the changes and to hear your thoughts. The full list of all new content and changes is below. Don't forget to [url=https://discord.gg/Xd8RPnRZjx ]join our Discord[/url] to chat with the dev team and share your feedback, and please let us know as soon as you can if anything looks like it's not working as intended.

[h3]This update includes some [b]major balancing changes[/b].[/h3]
Our vision for the game has always been for players to weigh up difficult decisions. Do you push deeper into a location to get what you need or get in and get out quickly? Do you welcome a desperate survivor into your shelter or refuse them because there's not enough resources to go around? Do you align yourself with a ruthless faction or betray them? These decisions should test your strategy and also your humanity, and they're part of what makes the game fun the first time around and satisfying to replay.

But lately we've been watching players and noticing some decisions just aren't as tricky as we intended them to be. The most noticeable of these is the decision of whether to welcome a new survivor into your shelter or not. We always wanted this to be a difficult decision, but currently there are very few downsides to recruitment and large numbers of players eagerly say yes to every single recruitable. While it's cheerful to see all our lovely characters with full needs all hanging out in a shelter, this wasn't exactly the way we pictured it. Instead, resources should be scarce, morale fragile and stomachs rumbling. Sending someone out into an infested world rife with enemies should be extraordinary, tense and dangerous. And having increasing numbers of people holed up in a tiny shelter in the middle of a Texas summer during a violent, apocalyptic outbreak should be a lot more challenging.

For this reason, we have [b]rebalanced the game[/b] to make the decision to say yes to recruitable survivors a little trickier. Namely:

[list]
[*] We have [b]decreased the number of survivors you can send scavenging[/b] to just [b]one per phase[/b], but you can [b]upgrade[/b] your Map station at the Workbench to unlock the ability to send [b]two per phase[/b].  

[*] We have [b]increased[/b] how much Hunger drains each phase and [b]decreased[/b] the amount of Hunger that food restores, so it will be harder to keep your survivors' stomachs full.
 
[*] We have [b]increased[/b] the number of timeslots it takes to dismantle an item and [b]decreased[/b] the number of items you get. 

[*] We have [b]removed[/b] the ability to use medical items while out scavenging.

[*] The zombie threat will increase over time, meaning discovered but not yet visited locations will [b]increase[/b] in difficulty as days progress.  [/list]

We know these are some big changes! But our playtests so far have shown us that this a) makes the overall experience more enjoyable and b) aligns the experience closer to our original vision for the game.

As always, though, we're looking forward to hearing your thoughts. 

Now onto the full notes.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43342513/9c85fd7d70dc7aade2d7c9289e8bd0b0ef941884.png[/img]

[h1]Update #1 Notes[/h1]

[h2]Curveballs[/h2]
Environmental and world events can now affect your shelter over time. These will appear in the form of shelter event popups, and can be positive or negative. The events can happen at random, or can be based on certain conditions such as the district you're in, the survivors who are in your shelter, or certain dates. 

[h2]Zombified Survivors ("Zurvivors")[/h2]
If your survivor is killed by a zombie while out scavenging, there is a chance you will encounter them as a zombie when you return to that location. 

[h2]New Throwables[/h2] 
We've expanded the range of throwables options. The [b]Brick[/b] does damage to enemies when thrown and can knock them back or down. The [b]Pebble[/b] will cause an enemy to go into a searching state, and is best used to split a single zombie from a group or move a stationary zombie. The [b]Pipe Bomb[/b] will explode immediately on contact with zombies or humans, or bounce on surfaces and explode after a certain amount of time. This explosion can also damage the player. These new throwables can now be discovered as loot around various locations, and the [b]Pipe Bomb[/b] is also craftable. 

[h2]Door Barging[/h2] 
If you run at an unlocked door fast enough, you can now crash through it. This causes minor health loss and a chance of injury, and means the door cannot be closed again.

[h2]New Starting Shelter[/h2] 
Stanton & Son Meats in the lovely district of Seneca is a new scavenging location that is also included as a potential starting shelter.


[h2]Other New Content[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added Elkins Family Clinic in the Kingside district.
[*] Added the Indigo Rose Hotel in the Downtown district.
[*] Added Heatwave, Sunburn, Sunstroke, Influenza and Queasy states.
[*] Added dialogue interactions when recruiting Aubrey, Frank, Joe and Rahul.
[*] Added more attack variations to human enemies. 
[*] Added Map panning, which gives players the ability to move around the map using the middle mouse button or the right controller analog stick.
[*] Added an additional suite of mouse actions, including the ability to use your mouse to interact with more of the shelter HUD, move between survivors in the shelter, and go to the next item in NPC interactions.
[*] Added the ability to cancel a survivor's assignment to a shelter station without having to enter the shelter station screen.
[/list]

[h2]Adjustments[/h2]
[list]
[*] Changed survivor recruitment so If you visit a location and decline to recruit a survivor, they will not be there when you return.
[*] Cooking recipes no longer have a water requirement to start with. This changes with certain Curveballs. 
[*] Adjusted Barb's specific loot point so that it only appears after she mentions it. 
[*] Adjusted Hudson's specific loot point so that it only appears after he mentions it. 
[*] Stealth killing will now ragdoll zombies, causing them to fall to the ground using physics. 
[*] Adjusted zombie spawning in Bloomingburg Books so it starts off easier but gets more difficult later in the game.
[*] Changed the speed of certain zombie reactions when using different weapons.
[*] Reduced the damage from some of the human enemy weapons.
[*] Adjusted the pistol and revolver's muzzle flash so it now emits a light that illuminates the environment around them when they are fired.
[*] Human NPC scavengers now only appear after 5 days.
[*] Survivors with the first aid training trait now have cheaper recipes for splints. 
[*] Survivors without a wrist fracture can't consume splints.
[*] Millwood Manor's shed now requires a lockpick to unlock.
[*] Fire Station No.13 now has more areas to loot.
[*] Moved loot at Pogo's on 9th, Old Ballard and Jenson Elementary. 
[*] Improved zombie behavior at Victory Meat Processing so zombies don't run into walls.
[*] The shed in 15 Independence Blvd no longer shakes.
[*] Added additional survivor animations.
[*] Updated the pool cue stealth execution animation.
[*] Added and updated sound effects throughout the stages and in some UI screens.
[*] Graphical improvements and further optimization on Mercer High School, Bloomingburg Books, Texway Gas Green St, Mitchum Powell Plaza and RM&K Communications.
[*] Simplified and Traditional Chinese text are now left aligned instead of center aligned for better readability. 
[*] Adjusted the Map station so you now unassign a survivor by holding the right mouse button, circle on the Playstation controller, or B on the Xbox controller.
[*] Entering the Map screen again now saves your previous assignment. 
[*] Map location information now doesn't show Threat bar if you have selected your own shelter.
[*] Added tips to the loading screen.
[*] Added icons for the buttons on the side of the mouse.
[/list]


[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug with the conversation choices in The Network plan, so you can now [spoiler]only sell out Eva after you receive her note.[/spoiler]
[*] Fixed an issue with Eva's dialogue attribution.
[*] Fixed an issue where you couldn't [spoiler]attack Red in the Airlift plan.[/spoiler]
[*] Fixed a bug where you could consume Alcohol, Beer, Moonshine or Coffee while scavenging.
[*] Fixed an issue where shelter survivors in Texas Sports Supply sometimes walked into a left window.
[*] Fixed an issue with the rear fence in Texas Sports Supply where it was only climbable from one side.
[*] Fixed an issue at Texas Sports Supply causing zombies to see you when climbing the drainpipe.
[*] Fixed an issue where the emergency lights didn't persist in St Bernadette Hospital if you left and re-entered the stage after the power cut off.
[*] Fixed issue where sometimes zombies don't follow you into the next building in Bloomingburg Books and get stuck in the doorway.
[*] Fixed loot points in Fire Station No.13 where there was no visual for the item being looted.
[*] Fixed issue where survivors sometimes stalled out or clipped into things when roaming around the shelters.
[*] Fixed a bug where you could end up controlling two survivors in the shelter at the same time.
[*] Fixed an issue where you could sometimes jump instead of climb down even when you are inputting down.
[*] Fixed a bug where holding aim and interacting with an NPC caused you not to be able to use the NPC dialogue screen.
[*] Fixed an audio bug where some feminine human enemies were using masculine sounds.
[*] Fixed revolver so it plays reload audio now.
[*] Fixed some issues with loot point accessibility. 
[*] Fixed an issue with the Map where if you selected the Map after you'd assigned someone, it unassigned them. 
[*] Fixed issue where Exit to Main Menu popup didn't highlight your selected button when you were out scavenging.
[*] Fixed a crash related to the Options screen.
[*] Fixed some graphical issues on certain surfaces in the environment on medium settings.
[*] Fixed a bug where the Hope state in the Plans UI was missing translations.
[*] Various animation bug fixes and improvements.
[*] Various fixes and updates to UI screens and layouts.
[*] General fixes and improvements.
[/list]

And last but not least...

[h2]Some news on Update #2[/h2]

The major features of Early Access Update #2 will be 

[list]
[*] [b]Infection[/b]
[*] [b]Difficulty settings[/b]
[*] [b]New zombie threat[/b]
[/list]

and will be coming in [b]July[/b]. But more on that soon...

Harriet
& the Into the Dead team

notes.title: Dev Update #36: News from Walton
notes.content:
We're one week away from our first Early Access update, so we figured it was time for a dev update and check-in. 

[h2]Early Access Update #1 [/h2]

As a reminder, Update #1 will be releasing next week on [b]27 May PDT / 28 May NZST[/b] and will contain the following new features:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43342513/018d02c3bbddb5adc3b3f44dfe6c9c58281fddaa.png[/img]

[list]
[*] [b]CURVEBALLS: [/b]Environmental and world events can now affect your shelter over time. These can be positive or negative and may force you to alter your strategy.
[*] [b]ZOMBIFIED SURVIVORS: [/b]You may encounter your zombified survivors when returning to the location where they "died".
[*] [b]NEW THROWABLES: [/b]Expanded range including additional offensive, distraction, and explosive options.
[*] [b]DOOR BARGING: [/b]When you don't have time to be subtle, sprinting through a door may get you where you need to be faster.
[*] [b]NEW STARTING SHELTER:[/b] When starting your game, there will now be a new possible shelter location.
[/list]
As well as various general bug fixes and improvements.

Here's a sneak peek at some of the recent work in progress - with the usual reminder that it's in active development, could change and includes some placeholders!

[b]DOOR BARGING[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43342513/59a9c8535ac18f33a7d2868b0c03aaabfbc2c9b7.gif[/img]

[b]NEW THROWABLES[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43342513/414d2e6e30df3de108958bab13cc34cf03ac81cd.gif[/img]

[h2]General development[/h2]

Ongoing development for the game continues alongside our regular core updates. This includes exploration of roadmap features further down the road, like our trusty animal companions. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43342513/42ca8840e98c9ff56fbeaa24a32f51a26a62d8af.gif[/img]

We're also exploring other quality-of-life updates, including the much requested ability to easily navigate between your survivors, especially as your shelter gets full.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43342513/3819e38930c34f57c80bdf5af685266af62067c8.gif[/img]

And, as always, our art team continue to work on new locations for you to explore. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43342513/e59ade16e04793cde178dd8262baf5c06edd5f9a.png[/img]


[h2]Demo Availability[/h2]

With all of the above going on, we've gotten to the point now where the demo is lacking a number of core features, bug fixes and optimizations. We had to make a call on whether to focus the team's efforts on updating and optimizing the demo or working on new content, and we've made the call to focus our development solely on the full version of the game for now. 

For this reason, we want to give players advanced notice that we'll be [b]taking down our demo at the end of this week[/b]. If you've been meaning to try out the demo or you've been trying to get your friends to give it a go, tell them to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3182520/Into_the_Dead_Our_Darkest_Days_Demo/]have at it[/url] before the end of the day this [b]Thursday 22 May PDT / Friday 23 May NZST[/b]. As with all Steam games, players will still be able to play 2 hours of the full game and refund it if it's not for them (subject to Steam Ts&Cs).


[h2]Developer Livestream[/h2]

Our Senior Game Designer James Bodnar and Senior Programmer Sarah Dobie recently joined the team at Unity to do a little deep dive into zombie behaviour. Check out the playback of the stream over on YouTube if you're curious how some of our systems work from a technical standpoint: [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BMCAtKjP-Ao]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BMCAtKjP-Ao[/url]

______

That's all for now! We can't wait to hear your thoughts on the new update next week. Don't forget to join the Discord to chat directly to the team and let us know your feedback and ideas.

Harriet 
& the Into the Dead team

notes.title: Patch Notes: Hotfix v0.3.3
notes.content:
Hey folks! Phew, it's been a whirlwind launch week. Thank you so much to everyone who has bought the game, left a review, chatted in the forums, joined the Discord, streamed their playthroughs - we've been overwhelmed with the response.

We've been carefully reading through all of the comments and suggestions, and one of the major themes of the feedback we've been receiving is around weapon durability (or lack thereof). Weapon durability is an integral part of the gameplay and any changes we make to this have to be carefully balanced within the world of the game. Currently weapons have a lower durability but they're also easier to find and craft, so when we look to adjust things like durability, we also have to look at all the other areas of the game that this affects. 

Currently the design team are looking into weapons and combat as a larger body of holistic work for future updates, but in the meantime we've made a few smaller adjustments to durability which should address some of the feedback so far. 

[h2]Weapon Durability Changes[/h2]

This update has:

[list]
[*] [b]Extended[/b] the [b]durability[/b] of [b]all weapons[/b]. 
[*] Adjusted the [b]damage and durability tier[/b] of the Rake, Spiked Plank, Shovel, Lead Pipe, Crowbar and Pipe Wrench.
[*] [b]Reduced the drop rate of weapons in loot[/b], with larger reductions for higher damage and durability weapons.
[*] Increased the [b]material[/b] and [b]time requirements[/b] for crafting weapons.
[*] Adjusted [b]grounded executions[/b] so they no longer consume durability (except for the Bolt Pistol).
[/list]

We'd love to know how it's feeling, so drop a comment or review to let us know your thoughts. 

This update also includes a number of adjustments and improvements along with a decent bug exterminator. See the full list of changes below.

_____


[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a number of issues with zombie behavior in 9th Precinct Station, 22 Springwood Drive, 319 Schrader St, Fire Station No.8, Fire Station No.13, Galaxy Zone Arcade, Griffith & Sons Hardware, Harshaw Presbyterian, Millwood Manor, Old Ballard, St Bernadette Hospital, Texway Gas Hart St and Value Records. Zombies should no longer patrol in the background, crawl out from places they shouldn't or get stuck just standing there, among other generally weird behaviors.
[*] Fixed an issue where locations could repopulate with zombies after being cleared.
[*] Fixed an issue where zombies don't populate at some locations if you move shelters without using a Vantage Point.
[*] Fixed an issue where a zombie runs into a fence in Container Yard #3. Also fixed an issue where a zombie could not hear survivors through one of the doors in Container Yard #3. They're concentrating now.
[*] Fixed an issue where there was a patrolling zombie in the background of the Walton Taxi Depot. 
[*] Fixed an issue where killing zombies in front of the saloon doors in Thirty Ought Six Bar could eventually block survivors from entering those doors.  
[*] Fixed an issue where survivors couldn't get out of bed in the Fitzgerald House. Up and at 'em.
[*] Fixed an issue where survivors could get stuck on the top of the stairs when moving into the Fitzgerald House.
[*] Fixed an issue where if survivors visited St Bernadette Hospital before beginning the hospital objective in the Airlift Escape Plan, it could cause them to not be able to progress the plan.
[*] Fixed an issue where survivors could fall out of the world on the right side of St Bernadette Hospital. Also fixed some pathfinding issues in this location.
[*] Fixed some issues in Hackett Construction Inc. including an issue where survivors could get stuck on a ledge.
[*] Fixed an issue where the zombies in Pogo’s Greenhaven didn't scale with difficulty. Also fixed some smaller pathfinding and zombie spawning issues.
[*] Fixed an issue with the hydraulic lift in Lester Barr Automotive, which wasn't sticking to its previous setting when survivors revisited the stage, causing weird issues. This has also been improved to make crushing zombies happen more consistently. Nice.
[*] Fixed an issue with the portable beds in Aunty Mae's Truck Stop Diner intersecting the wall. We honor physics in this house.
[*] Fixed an issue where human enemies were doing more damage than intended. They're strong but they're not THAT strong.
[*] Fixed scissor damage as it didn't always damage threats when it looked like it should.
[*] Fixed an issue where survivors would climb down ledges even if players were holding "up" on their controls.
[*] Fixed an issue that was slowing down shader loading.
[*] FIxed an issue with the readability of the "All threats cleared" message in languages where it was a longer sentence.
[*] General fixes and improvements.
[/list]

[h2]Potential Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Potential fix for the "whiteout" issue that we have seen on certain graphics cards. Keep us updated on this one. 
[/list]

[h2]Adjustments[/h2]
[list]
[*] Adjusted the position of the Kinski Foundation Gallery and Ashby Hoarder’s House on the map. This makes traversing the length of the map easier.
[*] Added Vantage Points to Aunty Mae's Truck Stop Diner and Thirty Ought Six Bar. 
[*] Relocated the Vantage Point in Wash and Dry Laundromat.
[*] Adjusted the resource pips in the location description on the map. The pips won't disappear anymore when all the loot is taken from that location. Instead, it will show the empty pips.
[*] Adjusted the description for Unidentified Pills so it no longer references a bottle.
[*] Reduced Leo's breathing sound effects. (He's an athlete, after all.)
[*] Reduced the noise of stealth executions. These now make half the noise they did before.
[*] The Network bad ending now mutes other sounds.
[*] Consuming each of these items now plays a cool unique sound: Alcohol, Bandage, Beer, Can Of Dog Food, Casserole, Chilli Con Carne, Coffee, Crude Moonshine, Goulash, Healing Kit, Junk Food, Meat, Meat Stew, Medicine, Meat Slop, Vege Slop, Splint, Unidentified Pills, Vege Soup, and Vegetables.
[*] Reduced the additional damage received while a survivor has Bruised Ribs.
[*] Flesh Wound is now less likely to happen.
[*] Aligned the State icons to the bottom of the stamina bar while out scavenging.
[*] Localized Paused text in the pause screen.
[*] Removed extra glyph from Report a Bug screen.
[*] Optimization pass on Old Ballard.
[/list]

_____

Thanks so much for your support so far. Keep the feedback coming! 

And don't forget to join the Discord: https://discord.gg/Xd8RPnRZjx 

Harriet 
& the Into the Dead team

notes.title: FAQs and Troubleshooting
notes.content:
Need a helping hand to get started in Walton City? We've put together answers to some frequently asked questions, and explained some troubleshooting to common issues.

[h1]General Questions[/h1]

[h3][b]Where can I buy the game?[/b][/h3]
[list]
	[*]You can purchase [i][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2239710/Into_the_Dead_Our_Darkest_Days/" rel="noopener noreferrer]Into the Dead: Our Darkest Days[/url][/i][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2239710/Into_the_Dead_Our_Darkest_Days/" rel="noopener noreferrer] here on Steam[/url].
[/list]
[h3][b]How do I control the game?[/b][/h3]
[list]
	[*]Below are instructions for using an Xbox controller [b](XBOX)[/b], a PlayStation controller [b](PS)[/b], or keyboard and mouse controls. Other controllers may also function.
	[*]We recommend using a controller.
	[*]Detailed control schemes are available in-game or at the bottom of this page.
[/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h1]Gameplay Questions[/h1]

[h3][b]How do I assign survivors to tasks?[/b][/h3]

To progress in the game, you need to assign your survivors to different tasks like scavenging, resting, or rebuilding barricades.

Approach a shelter station with a survivor by moving using:
[list]
	[*][b]Left joystick[/b] on the controller 
	[*][b]WASD [/b]on the keyboard
[/list]
Once you are at a station, press:
[list]
	[*][b]Y (XBOX)[/b] or [b]Triangle (PS)[/b] on the controller
	[*][b]E[/b] on the keyboard to interact
[/list]
Add tasks to a survivor’s queue with:
[list]
	[*][b]A (XBOX)[/b] or [b]X (PS)[/b] on the controller
	[*][b]E[/b] on the keyboard
[/list]
Remove the last queued task on the shelter station screen by pressing:
[list]
	[*][b]X (XBOX)[/b] or [b]Square (PS)[/b] on the controller
	[*][b]R[/b] on the keyboard
[/list]
Go back with:
[list]
	[*][b]B (XBOX)[/b] or [b]Circle (PS)[/b] on the controller
	[*][b]Right mouse click[/b] to withdraw from the screen
[/list]
If your survivor is now doing an interaction animation at the station, they have been successfully assigned.
[h1] [/h1]
You can change to another survivor by using:
[list]
	[*]The [b]Directional Pad[/b] on the controller
	[*]The [b]number 1 and 2 keys[/b] on the keyboard
[/list]
Once you have assigned all survivors, you need to [b]end the current phase[/b] to progress the game.

To do this, hold:
[list]
	[*][b]RB (XBOX)[/b] or [b]R1 (PS)[/b] on the controller
	[*][b]R[/b] on the keyboard until the phase circle in the lower right corner of the screen is filled
[/list]
Then the phase will end, and your survivors will be set into action.

[h3][b]How do I send survivors to go scavenging in the city?[/b][/h3]

Survivors can be sent scavenging by using the map station in their current shelter.
[h1] [/h1]
Move a survivor to the map using:
[list]
	[*]The left joystick on the controller
	[*]WASD on the keyboard
[/list]
Then use:
[list]
	[*][b]Y (XBOX)[/b] or [b]Triangle (PS)[/b] on the controller
	[*][b]E[/b] on the keyboard to interact with the map
[/list]
Choose a location by:
[list]
	[*]Navigating to it with the [b]left joystick[/b] then pressing [b]A (XBOX)[/b] or [b]X (PS)[/b] on the controller
	[*]Left mouse clicking on it and then pressing [b]E[/b]
[/list]
Choose items in the shelter inventory for your survivor to take with them.

Once you have moved the items you want into your survivor’s backpack, press:
[list]
	[*][b]Y (XBOX)[/b] or [b]Triangle (PS)[/b] on the controller
	[*][b]R[/b] to go scavenging
[/list]
Once you end the current phase, your survivor will head out into Walton City.

[i]Tip: It’s always good to make sure you have plenty of weapons and lockpicks in your survivor’s backpack when they go scavenging![/i]

[h3][b]How do my survivors escape the city?[/b][/h3]

The goal of [i]Into the Dead: Our Darkest Days[/i] is to escape Walton City with as many survivors alive as possible.

Your survivors do this by completing one of a number of possible Escape Plans.

First:
[list]
	[*]Survivors need to discover a Plan Lead. Survivors can find these hidden around the city in different locations. A Lead will also unlock after a set amount of phases if your survivors have yet to find any.
[/list]
Once they get their first Lead:
[list]
	[*]Press the [b]Inventory[/b] button on the controller or [b]P[/b] on keyboard to view the [b]Inventory [/b]menu
	[*]Change to the [b]Plans[/b] menu. This will show you where to look for more Leads.
[/list]
Once your survivors have collected enough Leads, you’ll be alerted that an Escape Plan is available:
[list]
	[*]Visit the [b]Plans [/b]menu again to pin the Escape Plan.
	[*]Now your survivors need to follow the objectives listed in the top left of the game screen to progress through the Plan.
	[*]Be careful - if your survivors die or they fail to complete an objective, they won’t be able to complete the Plan and escape.
[/list]
[i]Tip: Make sure to investigate each location you scavenge thoroughly to make sure you don’t miss any Leads.[/i]

[h3][b]How do I heal my survivors?[/b][/h3]

In the shelter, your survivors can use a Healing Kit from the shelter inventory to instantly restore health. Sleeping will also restore a small amount of health.

If your survivor is suffering a physical state such as ‘Bruised Ribs’ or ‘Sprained Wrist’, they’ll need to use an item like a Bandage or a Splint to recover. If they have a psychological state such as ‘Nightmares’, they’ll need to use a shelter station like the Communal Area to recover. Usually it will require a few phases to pass before the survivor is fully healed from their state.

Check the state’s description in the [b]Survivor [/b]menu to see what it requires. To do this: 
[list]
	[*]Open the [b]Inventory [/b]and change to the [b]Survivor [/b]menu.
[/list]
[h3][b]How do my survivors use the flashlight?[/b][/h3]

All of your survivors already have a flashlight - they don’t need to craft or equip it.

To use it, aim using:
[list]
	[*]The [b]right joystick[/b] on the controller
	[*]Hold the [b]right mouse button[/b] while moving the mouse
[/list]
[h3][b]How do my survivors use a firearm?[/b][/h3]

Once you have a firearm, your survivor needs to equip it in the [b]Inventory [/b]screen. Then they can aim using the same controls as the flashlight.

Load the gun with:
[list]
	[*][b]RB (XBOX)[/b] or [b]R1 (PS)[/b] on controller
	[*][b]R[/b] on keyboard
[/list]
Fire with:
[list]
	[*][b]RT (XBOX)[/b] or [b]R2 (PS)[/b] on controller
	[*][b]Left mouse click[/b] on the mouse
[/list]
Keep an eye on your survivor’s ammo in the lower left of the game screen and don’t forget to reload!
[i]Tip: Your survivor needs the right kind of ammo to fire their gun e.g. a pistol uses pistol ammo only.[/i]

[h3][b]How do my survivors throw distractions?[/b][/h3]

Your survivor can throw things like glass bottles to distract zombies.

Equip the item in your survivor’s inventory.

Aim with:
[list]
	[*]The [b]right joystick[/b] on the controller
	[*]Or hold the [b]right mouse button[/b] and move the mouse
[/list]
Then press:
[list]
	[*][b]RT (XBOX)[/b] or [b]R2 (PS)[/b] or [b]left mouse click[/b] to throw
[/list]
[i]Tip: Your survivor cannot have throwable items and a firearm equipped at the same time.[/i]

[h3][b]When my survivors move into a new shelter, what happens to the location's loot?[/b][/h3]

Some locations can be cleared of zombies and be turned into new shelters. When survivors move in, [b]all the loot in that location will automatically be added to the shelter's inventory[/b]. 

[h3][b]What about shelter upgrades?[/b][/h3]

Any station that is upgradable will move with your survivors (e.g. Weapons Bench). Stations that are not upgradable are specific only to certain locations (e.g. Garden). Those won't move with your survivors.

[h3][b]What are the circles on the ground in scavenging locations for?[/b][/h3]

Gray circles indicate cover, where your survivor can hide.

To use them, press:
[list]
	[*][b]Up on the joystick[/b] or [b]W[/b] on the keyboard to take cover
	[*][b]Down on the joystick[/b] or [b]S[/b] on the keyboard to move out of the cover spot
[/list]
Some cover spots will hide you from zombies approaching in either direction, while others will only hide you from zombies approaching in one direction.
Cover also doesn't work if a zombie is chasing your survivor or is already aware of their presence.

[i]Tip: Your survivor can throw distraction items like bottles or aim their gun from cover.[/i]

[h3][b]Why do my survivors keep alerting zombies?[/b][/h3]

Stealth is key to surviving Walton City.

Make sure to toggle sneaking with:
[list]
	[*][b]B (XBOX)[/b] or [b]Circle (PS)[/b] on controller
	[*][b]Left Ctrl[/b] on keyboard when moving around in the city
[/list]
If your survivor makes a loud noise, like attacking a zombie, running, or firing a gun, it will alert zombies around them.
Zombies that are dormant in the background or foreground might move to the middle ground (where they can hurt your survivor) when awoken, even if they’re off-screen.
Certain actions cannot be done silently, like opening rolling garage doors.

[i]Tip:[/i]
[list]
	[*][i]Some zombies will let out a primal scream when alerted, which will call other zombies to them.[/i]
	[*][i]Make sure to quickly kill zombies that are winding up for a primal scream before they can complete it![/i]
[/list]
[h3][b]Why aren’t my survivors responding?[/b][/h3]

If your survivor isn’t responding to controls or you’re missing button prompts, try the following:
[list]
	[*]Launch the game using [b]DirectX11[/b].
	[*]Check if all survivors are assigned to shelter stations properly. (If they’re not doing an interaction animation (and are just standing idle in front of the station) then they are not assigned to it.)
	[*]Restart the game to refresh inputs.
[/list]
[h3][b]How do I report a bug?[/b][/h3]

The best way to report a bug is to use the in-game bug reporting system. Please include as much detail as you can to help our development team squash that bug! You can also report bugs by emailing support@pikpok.com or joining our Discord and using the Bug Report channel.

We are just over [b]2 weeks away[/b] from our Early Access release.

To give players an idea of what to expect from the Early Access journey, today we're releasing our [b]Early Access roadmap[/b]. This highlights what's coming for our very first update in May 2025, along with a list of all our intended new features and content that will be added over the course of the next 12 to 18 months.

Major updates will be released every 4 to 6 weeks, and each update will have a mixture of the features listed in "Future Early Access Content". Details of the exact features included in each update will be announced shortly before the update is released. All players who purchase the Early Access version of the game will automatically get access to each of these features as they're rolled out.

There will also be some things we'll continuously update, especially bug fixes and general improvements, so you'll see hotfixes and patches more frequently than major updates.

Rest assured we'll also be continuously taking on player feedback. Some of you may even notice suggestions that you've made already on the roadmap below. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43342513/fe651299c34946e1fd579443bc617a6911bfcab7.png[/img]

Plain text is below:

_____

[h1]EARLY ACCESS ROADMAP[/h1]

Major updates will be released every 4 - 6 weeks throughout the Early Access period. Each update will have a mixture of the features listed in "Future Early Access Content" below. Details of exact content included in the update will be announced shortly before the update is released. All players who've purchased the Early Access version will receive these updates for free.

[h3][b]EARLY ACCESS: 12 - 18 MONTHS
MAJOR UPDATES: EVERY 4 - 6 WEEKS
ONGOING DEVELOPMENT: REGULAR HOTFIXES & PATCHES[/b][/h3]

[h3]UPDATE ONE MAY 2025[/h3]

[list]
[*] [b]CURVEBALLS: [/b]Environmental and world events can now affect your shelter over time. These can be positive or negative and may force you to alter your strategy.
[*] [b]ZOMBIFIED SURVIVORS: [/b]You may encounter your zombified survivors when returning to the location where they "died".
[*] [b]NEW THROWABLES: [/b]Expanded range including additional offensive, distraction, and explosive options.
[*] [b]DOOR BARGING: [/b]When you don't have time to be subtle, sprinting through a door may get you where you need to be faster.
[*] [b]NEW STARTING SHELTER:[/b] When starting your game, there will now be a new possible shelter location.
[*] Various general fixes and improvements.
[/list]

[h3]FUTURE EARLY ACCESS CONTENT[/h3]

[list]
[*][b] SHELTER: [/b]Shelter breaches and enemy raids, food degrading, additional crafting recipes, new shelter stations
[*] [b]SCAVENGING: [/b]Expanded map, new districts, new scavenging locations, elevators, changing environmental factors, expanded lore 
[*] [b]WORLD: [/b]Water and power cuts, faction and military activity, weather and environmental effects
[*] [b]PLANS: [/b]New and more dynamic escape plans, survivor side missions, unlockable content after completing plans
[*] [b]ZOMBIES:[/b] New individual and cluster behavior, mourning, additional attacks, hordes will eventually overwhelm your shelter
[*] [b]SURVIVORS: [/b]New survivors, character bonds and relationships, skills system, armor, disease, deeper injury and trauma recovery system
[*] [b]NPCS:[/b] Traders, factions, recruitment, firearm usage, NPC quests, improved human behaviors
[*] [b]INFECTION: [/b]Zombie bite and survivor turning mechanics, infection symptoms
[*] [b]COMBAT: [/b]Additional combat moves, ledge and ladder grabbing, improved grappling, new environmental kills
[*] [b]WEAPONS: [/b]New discoverable and craftable weapons, assault rifles, shotguns, bows, traps
[*] [b]SCENARIOS: [/b]Customizable starting scenarios for different playthroughs
[*] [b]DOGS: [/b]Your best friend in the apocalypse.
[*] [b]VISUAL IMPROVEMENTS: [/b]Ongoing optimization, additional graphic options, new animations
[*] [b]AUDIO IMPROVEMENTS: [/b]Adaptive key moment soundtracks, dynamic audio system improvements
[*] [b]UX/UI IMPROVEMENTS: [/b]Difficulty customization, improved accessibility options, save slots, Steam achievements
[/list]

THIS ROADMAP IS NOT EXHAUSTIVE AND IS SUBJECT TO CHANGE.

_____

Questions? Comments? Feedback? Jump into the Discord to chat with our dev team now: https://discord.gg/Xd8RPnRZjx 

We appreciate all the support you've shown us so far. We couldn't have done it without you and we can't wait to keep sharing Walton City with you.

See you soon!

Harriet & the Into the Dead team

notes.title: Intel Graphics: Brightness & Rendering Issues
notes.content:
Hey folks,

We've noticed that some players on Intel Graphics have been experiencing rendering issues. Some of you may have noticed a brightness bug that looks a little something like this:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43342513/37b3d0cda2847cbec4656f10f900a13551d9f22c.png[/img]

This should now be fixed with the latest update. 

Some players may be experiencing an artifacting bug that looks like this:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43342513/a84d1196ad092cbf700ac31d5e88a6b37c489dab.png[/img]

We've outlined some steps below that should solve the problem.

1) First, make sure your graphics drivers are [b]up to date[/b]. You can do that [url=https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/support/articles/000090440/graphics.html]here[/url]. 

2) If it's still an issue, we recommend using [b]DirectX11[/b] instead of [b]DirectX12[/b] for rendering. This can be set by adjusting your Steam [url=https://help.steampowered.com/en/faqs/view/7D01-D2DD-D75E-2955]Game Launch Options[/url] as follows:

[list]
[*] Open your [b]Steam Library[/b]
[*] Right click on Into the Dead: Our Darkest Days Demo and select [b]Properties[/b]
[*] On the [b]General[/b] tab, you'll find the [b]Launch Options[/b] section
[*] Enter [b]-force-d3d11[/b] in the box
[*] Close the Properties window and re-launch the game.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43342513/a925f4d31f1e8ab64b944e484db9597c0a1f6404.png[/img]

(Note that loading may take slightly longer depending on your PC.)

Let us know in the comments below if you've tried the above and you're still facing issues.

Harriet & the Team

notes.title: Dev Update #30: Four Hundred Thousand
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43342513/0ff536fa30dea38b5803fd3a424d74c949aace59.png[/img]

It's our first post of 2025 and we're thrilled to share we've hit [b]400,000[/b] wishlists here on Steam! It's damn exciting to have you all along with us for the ride, so thank you for your continued support.

The eagle-eyed among you will have noticed we've updated our Early Access release date here on Steam to [b]Q2 2025[/b]. We'll give you more details closer to the time, along with what you can expect post Early Access release as we continue to work and update the game.

In the meantime, we figured we'd give you a quick peek into what we're been working on... 


_______


[h2]Keyboard and controller rebinding[/h2]

We know you've been waiting on this one, so we can confirm it's coming!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43342513/8229385c5ff5c679dafbe2867e9eb6c2057617b7.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43342513/68107cc6783e399bb238eb3b478f56fadefedeb5.gif[/img]

We're just in the process of testing to make sure it's good to go.

_______


[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]

A few people have asked if it was our intention to have the sun burn so bright on certain devices that it blows out the entire screen with blinding light and we can confirm that this was, in fact, not our creative vision. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43342513/37b3d0cda2847cbec4656f10f900a13551d9f22c.png[/img]

Even though it does appear to be only affecting devices that are technically below our stated minimum specs (and please let us know if that's not the case for you) we've been working to get to the bottom of this issue. Recently we actually managed to fix the sun effect but as soon as that stopped, we unearthed something even more bizarre, so stay tuned on this front. The TL;DR is we're aware and we're still trying to crack it.

_______


[h2]New Features and Content[/h2]

[h3]New gameplay[/h3]

Throwables and distractions have always been an intended part of the experience so we're looking forward to introducing them into the game. Might help you get out of a tight spot.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43342513/5b997bdf6f3ab7f7b2f4d30a7cb501a0ba8b9f29.gif[/img]

[h3]New characters[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43342513/794229ee6f6d26012bdb78c30ee588933f4e82bb.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43342513/d1304345741617c5ea68bb5036ed4964738448e8.gif[/img]

And some new friends.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43342513/e1528fd6f3dc0483251175a700c2fe7139ff2402.png[/img]

Some will be available upon Early Access release, and others you'll meet further down the track.

[h3]New locations[/h3]

We'll be adding new levels to the game throughout the Early Access period, and making sure the different neighborhoods of Walton City have a distinct character and feeling is an important part of the experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43342513/eb6af57a87d65429f6295664202952bb25e8cd03.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43342513/d901a8c80a4188803ed92db2a520efa4c2d3a473.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43342513/435a27900ccd4c5d27aeccc0c67bebca9f3784f5.png[/img]

_______


Anyway, stay cool...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43342513/12a259afd10672f63f7deaef9bfca3faa41bebc2.gif[/img]

And keep your eyes peeled for a big announcement coming next week...

Harriet

notes.title: Dev Update #29: Happy Holidays
notes.content:
Well, folks, we've come a long way since the beginning of the year.

We want to extend a massive thank you to the players who've been following us and believing in the game throughout the entire development journey, and especially to those who've been following the Steam page since our announcement back in 2022. We also want to say a big welcome to all the new players who've arrived since the launch of our demo this October. Finally seeing it in your hands and seeing you experience it for the first time has been so exciting (not to mention informative) and we've got tons of ideas to run with from here. (For those of you who stumble upon bugs, we log each and every comment and we're still working through fixes, so keep the reports coming! It helps us immensely.)

We're taking a much needed break for the holidays, closing up shop completely from [b]Saturday 21 December NZDT[/b] and returning back to the Wellington office from [b]Monday 6 January NZDT[/b]. 

When we come back for 2025, we going to hit the ground running. We'll have our:

[list]
[*] Early Access [b]date announcement[/b]
[*] Early Access [b]roadmap reveal[/b]
[*] Early Access [b]launch[/b]
[*] Early Access [b]feature and gameplay updates [/b] begin 
[/list]

And we can't wait to share it all with you. 

In the meantime, feel free to join our Discord to chat suggestions, ideas and tips with other players and ask questions to our devs: https://discord.gg/decJp9nKwT

All the best, happy holidays, and see you soon.

Hello everyone! Hello to those who've been following our journey for the past couple of years, and hello to those who have just started following. We've had a massive influx of new wishlists and new follows since our [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xHZO5ugMIWw]PC Gaming Show trailer[/url] and we're overwhelmed and grateful, to say the least. 

On to news.

[h2]Bitsummit[/h2]

We're excited to announce that[b] Into the Dead: Our Darkest Days[/b] is heading to Japan. We'll have a booth set up at BitSummit in Kyoto next week from 19-21 July showcasing our scavenging demo. Keep an eye out for booth SV-11, and if you're there at the event, come over and put your survival skills to the test.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43342513/a47607de702d6fd0fc68140182bfe7089e428266.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43342513/2a2e480fce92aba09b5d0319138fb826e529d1b0.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43342513/dfc0bc09ac8adb5eb4d5b2dc4a4f7eb03844cd7b.png[/img]


[h2]Game Progress[/h2]

[h3]Fall damage[/h3]

Those of you who played our scavenging demo at PAX Aus or PAX East may have noticed your character experiencing no fall damage, and felt safe and comforted by this fact. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43342513/2b45541b715592ec45c340c98bfd3a63e7192e77.gif[/img]
[i]*Emphasized for comedic effect.[/i]

We're sorry to say that this will be coming to an end, and there will be consequences for leaping out of an open window or dropping 20 feet from a precarious ledge.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43342513/f6989a4abadb26cd24328bc3a74352f15cd3b509.gif[/img]

The eagle-eyed amongst you will notice the "state gained" popup. (This also surfaced in our latest trailer.) Character states are temporary but need addressing, whereas character traits are permanent. More on this soon. 

[h3]Expanded weaponry[/h3]

We've been working on a wider range of weapons. Some are beloved favorites...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43342513/0173e40834dbfdd6022ad8b7fc9aa076025e7426.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43342513/f0cb6a67957b22e08e4f350d08b7f6cb3171e547.gif[/img]

And some are slightly less common, although can be just as effective if timed correctly.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43342513/c85aea52d5660cbfa52a75bf60994a26b688858e.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43342513/5a19b2d2aca251cd688ffbf296e4252add106208.gif[/img]

Weapons are hard to come by, and their durability and strength — as well as their sound — differs, so making the right choice at the right moment is an important part of the game experience.  

[h3]Executions[/h3]

We've been expanding our range of execution animations to fit a wider range of weapons, too. This is always a particularly satisfying endeavor. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43342513/57d0047dbc8ec3446b30bd48cfd205061a800939.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43342513/5519d5a679d4978c1d3a8d08348e83a97834cd88.gif[/img]

[h3]New props[/h3]

Sleep is an ever-present requirement for your survivors. We've been working on a range of makeshift beds and bedding.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43342513/ef87f2f932a55d9ad3d5ca81d755a273cc408921.png[/img]

[h3]New levels[/h3]

As ever, we're expanding our levels. The glasshouse has been a team favourite.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43342513/7c16a2d8512459bb71178b48933ebd113a34e40a.png[/img]

[h3]Shelter ambience[/h3]

And we've been doing some early explorations of ambient music and audio. This is subject to change but we thought you'd like to hear some early concepts...

[previewyoutube=uEfnx4xPDds;full][/previewyoutube]

That's all for now. Three months until the public demo on Steam! Don't forget to follow us on socials.

notes.title: Dev Update #23: One Hundred Thousand
notes.content:
A busy month, and a lot of exciting news to share.

[h2]Milestone[/h2]

First and foremost: we just hit 100,000 wishlists here on Steam!

An insane milestone for us, and we're grateful to have you all here. It's encouraging to have so much interest in our game already. We're working hard to live up to your expectations, and we can't wait to finally share our first public demo with you this October.

[h2]PC Gaming Show[/h2]

We can finally announce we'll be featured in this year's PC Gaming Show!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43342513/d2a6a6e5c64c18f1ffce63bb264ebfd0d67bcb9b.jpg[/img]

It's the 10th anniversary of the show and we're delighted to be included in the lineup. We have to stay tight-lipped about our reveal, other than sharing that there'll be brand new, never-before-seen footage from the game, and the whole show will be well worth a watch. 

The show will be airing on Sunday 9 June (which is Monday 10 June for us here in New Zealand). You can catch the stream on Twitch or YouTube, and for more information about this year's event, check out the announcement here: https://www.pcgamer.com/gaming-industry/events-conferences/the-pc-gaming-show-returns-this-june/ 

Twitch stream: https://www.twitch.tv/pcgamer 
YouTube stream: https://www.youtube.com/@pcgamer 

[h2]Progress Update[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43342513/eb94f853922393d42a276f409fdad77cd37ca2bb.gif[/img]

[h3]Firearms[/h3]

Firearms are an important part of the game, but they come with a price. This last month our team has been focusing on an alert system that may bring previously unseen enemies to your location at the sound of a firearm being fired. Previously, there hasn't been any downside to a gun's power, and we want to make sure our players are weighing up every decision... carefully.

[h3]Backplane Enemies[/h3]

We've also been hard at work tweaking our backplane enemies. Previously, players at PAX Australia and PAX East quickly realised they were safe from "background" enemies who were just "set dressing", and it's important to us that every enemy (seen or unseen) feels like a threat, and that any assumptions of safety, especially if made on gameplay mechanics, are dangerous...

[h3]Art and Props[/h3]

A sneak peek into some work-in-progress traps...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43342513/b5944056fa346db9226a96f5bf5122e3a55a731c.png[/img]

... and shelter stations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43342513/354731b7e44edf5676d829ec6772c03298c5efd1.png[/img]


[h2]Keep Up To Date[/h2]

[h3]TikTok[/h3]
If you'd like to see more raw/unfinished gameplay capture, chat directly to our team, or get video answers to your questions, give us a follow on our TikTok page and jump into the comments. We're posting and answering questions regularly. 

tiktok.com/@intothedeadofficial 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43342513/545ea0ff31e4e566de95dacd45878e7014ec0328.png[/img]

[h3]YouTube[/h3]
And for deeper dives, head on over to our YouTube channel, where we post all our teasers, trailers, player interviews and developer diaries.

https://www.youtube.com/@pikpokgames 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43342513/16d7299d5284ff40359b9b93a38d103d8e147e3e.png[/img]

[h3]Website[/h3]
For general news about the Into the Dead franchise, to download our press kit, or to get in touch with us about publicity, content creator collaboration, or business opportunities, head to our website.

https://intothedead.com/ 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43342513/3fb30a8b3bad37d7df32f8fb434fa53a5b6286a5.png[/img]

Or give us a follow on the usual suspects.

Facebook: facebook.com/intothedeadgame 
Instagram: instagram.com/intothedeadofficial 
Twitter: twitter.com/intothedead 


[h2]That's all, folks...[/h2]

Keep refreshed, and we'll see you soon.

notes.title: Dev Update #22: Six Months Until Demo
notes.content:
Hello to all our new followers! It's great to have you all here.

We're six months out from our very first public demo on Steam, so here's an update of where we're at currently, and where we're headed.

[h1]PAX East 2024 Review Roundup[/h1]

In March we brought our scavenging demo to gaming reviewers and content creators at PAX East in Boston and got an amazingly encouraging result. We've shared some of our favourite quotes below, but feel free to read each review in full.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43342513/322c1b4b10082e27d0592de77c9273496ed2625b.jpg[/img]

[h3]Our 16 Favorite Games from PAX East 2024 - IGN[/h3]
"It was a devastating run; I had only made a couple mistakes, and it had cost me everything. But sneaking through rooms of zombies, fighting when I had to, running when things got dire, and taking risks is a rewarding loop that rewards you for playing well, and I could see how I could have done better each time I made a mistake.[b] I can’t wait for another shot at it.[/b]"
[url=https://www.ign.com/articles/our-16-favorite-games-from-pax-east-2024]Full review here.[/url]

[h3]‘Into The Dead: Our Darkest Days’ is an Evolved Survival Zombie Gaming Experience [PAX Preview] - Dread Central[/h3]
"If there is one facet of horror games that is congested, it is the zombie apocalypse-centered games. That is not to say they are all bad or the same, but there are a lot of them, and you need to strive to make a unique entry into the genre to gain some footing. Thankfully, with my short time with Into the Dead: Our Darkest Days, it’s easy to see they are trying something different that [b]sets them apart from the rest[/b]." 
[url=https://www.dreadcentral.com/news/499832/into-the-dead-our-darkest-days-is-an-evolved-survival-zombie-gaming-experience-pax-preview/]Full review here.[/url]

[h3]Into the Dead: Our Darkest Days is dialing up 80s zombie horror - ShackNews[/h3]
"The emphasis on stealth creates some [b]grippingly tense moments[/b], and the permadeath mechanic [b]keeps the stakes high at all times[/b]. The game is currently set for a 2025 launch, but the developers told me that a public demo may be in the cards this fall." 
[url=https://www.shacknews.com/article/139250/into-the-dead-our-darkest-days-preview]Full review here.[/url] [i] (CM note: Yes, we can confirm that the public Steam demo is indeed on the cards for October!)[/i]

[h3]Into the Dead: Our Darkest Days Is an 80s 2.5D State of Decay - Niche Gamer[/h3]
"From the variety of tormented zombies crying and rocking in the fetal position to an area in the basement that almost caused me a full-blown panic attack due to the chilling audio, I was [b]blown away[/b] by just how immersed I was in Into the Dead: Our Darkest Days by the end of the demo.  After getting my second survivor killed exploring too much, my third survivor made it out by running away from a terrifying horde that blocked the entrance. Overall, I was pleasantly surprised with just how much I liked this PikPok title, as its design and premise were [b]enthralling and unique[/b]."
[url=https://nichegamer.com/into-the-dead-our-darkest-days-is-an-80s-2-5d-state-of-decay/]Full review here.[/url]

[h3]PAX East 2024 Preview: ‘Into the Dead: Our Darkest Days’ - Blog Critics[/h3]
"While the demo did not show the full features of the game [b]I was amazed from the start [/b]with the visual presentation, music and most importantly gameplay mechanics. Stealth, planning, exploration, and resource management will play a key part in the game and what I checked out was very promising."
[url=https://blogcritics.org/pax-east-2024-preview-into-the-dead-our-darkest-days/]Full review here.[/url]



[h1]The Mix | Kinda Funny Spring Game Showcase - Gameplay Teaser[/h1]

We also dropped our first gameplay teaser in The Mix | Kinda Funny Spring Game Showcase, which you can check out below if you missed it.

[previewyoutube=zKR5N-K3GDg;full][/previewyoutube]

A lot of the UI for the game is still work-in-progress, which is why we've opted not to show it yet, but all will be revealed in time. Everything else you see represented is captured in-engine and is true to the experience of playing the game, so if you're wondering what the game "feels" like to play, this should give you a solid idea. (But yes, keep your eyes peeled for more gameplay coming soon...)



[h1]Languages Update[/h1]

We've had many questions about the translation of this title, and we can now confirm that we'll be releasing into Early Access with full audio, interface and subtitles in English, and interface and subtitles in Simplified Chinese, French, German, Spanish, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese and Russian. If there are any languages you're desperate to see added as we move into our full release, please let us know in the comments below. We may not be able to accommodate your request but it's useful for us to get an idea.



[h1]Current Work in Progress[/h1]

So, it's April 2024, six months out from our first demo. Where is the team at?

Currently the team are working hard preparing for our October Steam demo launch. Our initial demo that we've showcased at PAX Australia and PAX East was just a portion of the scavenging experience, but this new demo will expand on that for an entirely new taste of the gameplay.

Our level designers are mapping out new areas for you to explore....

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43342513/6024969b288c5c68ab8f2833c9384df151a5fead.png[/img]

Our art team are focusing on in-game swag, keeping that 1980s aesthetic alive...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43342513/4eecbd783517a75ab99e6391fbba0fc200581197.png[/img]

Our concept artists are working on a new piece of key art, focusing on our survivors...

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43342513/a53f404365a61f654682bb8345eda19b0e10884c.png[/img]

And, as ever, our animation team have been working hard with local motion capture talent...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43342513/aec062d078ca497a661e1828963c025f4bced9e7.jpg[/img]

...to figure out new ways to die.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43342513/31505068eee0210088b1749e04fd48c854793bde.gif[/img]


[h1]Coming Up[/h1]

Some event announcements and some new reveals. Stuff we're super excited about but can't share yet! Keep your eyes open. And don't forget to follow us on socials:

Facebook: facebook.com/intothedeadgame 
Instagram: instagram.com/intothedeadofficial 
Twitter: twitter.com/intothedead 
TikTok: tiktok.com/@intothedeadofficial 

See you soon!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43342513/4b9f66ae578650947989a36f15e3b2222ed99de0.png[/img]

[i]N.B: All images shared are work in progress, and subject to change. [/i]

Harriet
Community Manager

notes.title: Dev Update #20: Gameplay Teaser
notes.content:
It's here!

Off the back of [b]The Mix | Kinda Funny Spring Showcase[/b], we're thrilled to finally reveal our first gameplay teaser. It's an early taste of the experience players can expect with Into the Dead: Our Darkest Days. This was rendered entirely in-engine by our in-house development team, and features some all-new survivor characters. Some of you may even recognize a few moments from our very first demo, if you survived that far...

[previewyoutube=zKR5N-K3GDg;full][/previewyoutube]

This is just a glimpse, and as we progress with development we're looking forward to sharing more with you along the way.

Enjoy!

We're populating Walton City with characters.
